title: argo-events (koorikla wrapper)
description: Platform keys only; the upstream argo-events subchart, cluster.* and installation keys stay open. Cross-field rules: templates/validate.yaml.

argo-events.description: Upstream argoproj/argo-events subchart values (not constrained here).

host.description: Base hostname of the control plane Gateway (routes are <hostPrefix>.<host>).

workflowPlane.description: Render workflow objects: auto (Argo Workflows CRDs present and installation plane on), true or false.

clusters.description: Clusters whose Falco sidekick posts here (DNS-1123 labels; generated by the ApplicationSet).

minimumPriority.description: Lowest Falco priority that triggers a response (first letter may be upper case).

autoBuildWebhook.description: GitHub push webhook that triggers OpenChoreo builds (openchoreo.workflowPlane.autoBuild webhook).
